features.jobBody: Umwirondoro umwe, moteri ya kabiri. Akazi yubaha igihugu wahisemo - hamwe ninoti ziboneye.

about.title: Bourse nakazi, bihuye nimpamvu.
about.lede: Yubatswe kubantu barambiwe kuzunguruka ibibaho rusange. Injira ibyo wize nibyo ushobora gukora - dukurikirana urutonde hanyuma tuvuge impamvu bihuye.
about.ideaTitle: Guhuza bigomba kumva nkibisobanuro, ntabwo ari uguhuza.
about.ideaBody1: Shakisha moteri hamwe namahirwe yerekana amajwi. Ntibakunze kumenya impamyabumenyi yawe ya mudasobwa, ubuhanga bwawe bwo gukora, cyangwa ko usaba muri Botswana - kandi ntibigera basobanura ibikwiye.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic ikomeza umwirondoro umwe muzima kandi ikora buruse nakazi gahuye nayo. Ibisubizo byose bitwara amanota, isoko, nimpamvu ushobora gukoresha mubyukuri.
about.p1Body: Impamyabumenyi, ubuhanga, nigihugu nisoko yukuri. Imikino irubaka iyo ubihinduye.
about.p2Body: Amanota adafite ibisobanuro ni urusaku. Twanditse impamvu urutonde ruhuye - mururimi rworoshye.
about.p3Body: Turavumbura kandi tugashyira kumurongo. Usaba buruse yemewe cyangwa kurubuga rwabakoresha.
about.areItem1: Umwirondoro-uzi buruse hamwe nakazi gahuye nakazi
about.areItem2: Inama ya Playbook yihariye ubuhanga bwawe n'intego zawe
about.areItem3: Bika, wirukane, kandi wohereze mugihe umwirondoro wawe uhindutse
about.notItem1: Ntabwo dutanga buruse cyangwa ngo dukoreshe umuntu
about.notItem3: Buri gihe ugenzure igihe ntarengwa kurutonde rwemewe
about.studioBody: Opportunistic ™ ni Ibicuruzwa bizaza - byashizweho kugirango wumve neza, utuje, kandi bifite akamaro, ntabwo bimeze nkikindi cyitegererezo.
about.ctaBody: Kora konti, wemeze ubuhanga uhereye kumpamyabumenyi yawe, hanyuma ufungure urutonde rwimpamvu hamwe nimpamvu.

privacy.title: Politiki Yibanga
privacy.lede: Isi yose-kurinda amakuru yibanze, kugenzura kuki ikora, nuburenganzira busobanutse - ivugururwa kuri Opportunistic.
privacy.langNote: Iyi politiki yuzuye irerekanwa mururimi wahisemo.

terms.title: Amategeko yo gukoresha
terms.lede: Amategeko yo gukoresha Opportunistic nk'urwego rwo kuvumbura - ntabwo ari uwatanze amahirwe ayo ari yo yose.

privacyBody.overview: Opportunistic (“twe”) itanga buruse no guhuza akazi. Iyi politiki isobanura ibyo dukusanya, impamvu, igihe tuzayibika, n'uburenganzira bwawe. Dushyira mu bikorwa urwego rwa GDPR kuri buri mukoresha ku isi yose, kandi twubaha amategeko akomeye aho akoreshwa (harimo UK GDPR yo mu Bwongereza, POPIA muri Afrika yepfo, hamwe nuburyo busa). Ubu ni bwo buryo bufatika bwo kubahiriza ibicuruzwa byacu - ntabwo ari inama zemewe n'amategeko kububasha bwawe.
privacyBody.lawfulContractDesc: Gukora konte yawe, guhuza, no gutanga serivisi wasabye
privacyBody.lawfulLegitimateDesc: Umutekano, gukumira ihohoterwa, serivisi yizewe - iringaniza uburenganzira bwawe
privacyBody.lawfulLegalDesc: Aho tugomba kubika cyangwa gutangaza amakuru dukurikije amategeko akurikizwa
privacyBody.storeAccountDesc: Imeri na auth ibyangombwa ukoresheje Supabase Auth
privacyBody.storeProfileDesc: Izina, igihugu, umutwe, bio, impamyabumenyi, nubuhanga winjiye
privacyBody.storeMatchesDesc: Umutwe, URL, isoko, gutekereza, amanota, no kubika / kwirukana leta
privacyBody.storeTechnicalDesc: Emera kuki, isomo rya kuki rikenewe mukwinjira, gusesengura kubushake niba ubyemereye
privacyBody.cookiesIntro: Dukoresha kuki yemewe (opp_consent) kugirango twibuke amahitamo yawe kugeza kumezi 12. Kuki zikenewe zikomeza kwemeza umutekano. Ibyifuzo, isesengura, hamwe nubucuruzi bwa kuki biremerera gusa nyuma yo guhitamo. Urashobora guhindura ibitekerezo byawe umwanya uwariwo wose.
privacyBody.cookiesNecessaryDesc: Auth session, umutekano, kubika ubu bushake
privacyBody.cookiesPreferencesDesc: Ububiko bwa UI butandukanye burenze kubyemererwa
privacyBody.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Ibipimo byo gukoresha - inyandiko zahagaritswe kugeza byemewe
privacyBody.cookiesMarketingDesc: Amatangazo yamamaza - inyandiko zahagaritswe kugeza byemewe
privacyBody.cookiesOrFooter: - cyangwa ukoreshe igenamiterere rya kuki mumutwe.
privacyBody.useBody: Umwirondoro wawe imbaraga zihuye ninama zifatika. Ntabwo tugurisha amakuru yihariye. Ntabwo dukoresha ibyangombwa byawe kugirango twubake imyirondoro yamamaza keretse wemereye neza kuki yamamaza ibicuruzwa hamwe nabafatanyabikorwa bamamaza bazamenyekana hano.
privacyBody.transfersBody: Ibikorwa Remezo birashobora gutunganya amakuru mukarere gakoreshwa nabaduhaye (urugero Supabase na Brevo). Aho amakuru ava mu gihugu cyawe, twishingikiriza kumutekano ukwiye wemejwe n'amategeko ya GDPR (nkingingo zisanzwe zamasezerano zitangwa nababitanga) kandi tugabanya ibyo tubika.
privacyBody.retentionBody: Konti no guhuza amakuru guma mugihe konte yawe ikora. Niba usibye amakuru yawe muri Igenamiterere, dukuraho umwirondoro, impamyabumenyi, ubuhanga, guhuza, n'amateka yo gushakisha mububiko bwa porogaramu. Kwiyandikisha kuri konti birashobora kandi gusabwa kuri salo@opportunistic.online. Inyandiko zemewe zishobora kubikwa nkikimenyetso cyo guhitamo kugeza igihe cya kuki cyangwa nkuko amategeko abiteganya.
privacyBody.rightsBody: Ukurikije aho utuye, urashobora kugira uburenganzira bwo kubona, gukosora, gusiba, kugabanya, ikintu, amakuru yicyambu, no gukuramo uruhushya. Turabubaha nkibanze shingiro ryisi. Urashobora guhindura umwirondoro wawe igihe icyo aricyo cyose hanyuma ugasiba amakuru yawe muri Igenamiterere.
privacyBody.childrenBody: Opportunistic ntabwo yerekeza kubana bari munsi yimyaka 16 (cyangwa imyaka yo hejuru-yemewe-yemewe mugihugu cyawe). Ntugashire konti niba uri munsi yimyaka. Niba twize dufite amakuru nkaya, tuzasiba.
privacyBody.sharingBody: Twasangiye amakuru nabatunganya bafasha kuyobora serivise: Supabase (auth / data base), Brevo (imeri yoherejwe mugihe bishoboka), hamwe no kwakira (Urupapuro rwa GitHub). Urutonde rufungura kurubuga rwagatatu hamwe na politiki yabo bwite. Ntabwo tugurisha amakuru yihariye.

termsBody.roleBody: Opportunistic ni urubuga rwo kuvumbura. Turagaragaza buruse-ya bourse hamwe nurutonde rwakazi ukurikije umwirondoro wawe. Ntabwo turi abatanga, umukoresha, cyangwa abatanga amahirwe ayo ari yo yose yerekanwe kurubuga.
termsBody.roleCallout: Buri gihe urangize gusaba kumurongo wemewe kurutonde. Opportunistic asobanura neza; inkomoko ifite ibyangombwa n'ibisubizo.
termsBody.accuracyBody: Urutonde rushobora guta igihe nyuma yo kwerekana urutonde. Buri gihe ugenzure ibyangombwa, igihe ntarengwa, nintambwe zo gusaba kurubuga rwinkomoko mbere yo gusaba. Guhuza amanota, gutekereza, hamwe ninama ni inama - ntabwo ari garanti yo kwemerwa, inkunga, cyangwa akazi.
termsBody.accountOthersDesc: Ntugashyireho amakuru yihariye yundi muntu utabiherewe uburenganzira
termsBody.accountFairDesc: Turashobora guhagarika konti zikoresha nabi guhuza cyangwa kugerageza gusiba serivisi
termsBody.liabilityBody: Ku buryo bwuzuye bwemewe n’amategeko, Opportunistic ntabwo agomba kuryozwa ibyemezo byafashwe hashingiwe ku rutonde rwagaragaye, harimo amahirwe yo gufunga, ibikubiye mu gice cya gatatu kidahwitse, cyangwa ibyifuzo bitatsinzwe.
termsBody.privacyAfter: asobanura ibyo dukusanya n'uburenganzira bwawe. Ihitamo rya kuki hamwe nubuhanga busa buremera gusa nyuma yo kubyemera ukoresheje ibendera rya kuki cyangwa igenamiterere rya kuki. Kuki zikenewe kubwumutekano, kwinjira, no kwibuka iryo hitamo rigumaho. Reba
termsBody.changesBody: Turashobora kuvugurura aya magambo uko ibicuruzwa bigenda bihinduka. Itariki Yavuguruwe hejuru yuru rupapuro iragaragaza ivugurura ryanyuma. Gukomeza gukoresha nyuma yimpinduka bivuze ko wemera amagambo yavuguruwe.

tips.sLeadership: Andika amagambo yubuyobozi yamagambo 150 atangirira kuri {{place}} akarangira nuburyo {{source}} igihembo kigwiza izo ngaruka.
tips.sModules: Shushanya amateka yawe {{field}} kuri modules 3 kuri gahunda {{location}} gahunda - vuga module mubitekerezo byawe bwite.
tips.sEssaySkills: Mu nyandiko ya 1, tanga igika kimwe kuburyo {{skills}} yamaze gutanga ibisubizo bipimye (imibare ikubita inyito).
tips.sAdvanced: Kuyobora hamwe nubujyakuzimu bwa {{skill}} ({{level}}) nkikimenyetso ushobora gukoresha {{intensity}} ubukana.
tips.sWeak: Mbere yo gutanga, uzamure {{skill}} hamwe n'umushinga mugufi cyangwa icyemezo - abasesengura babona ubuhanga butarangiye.
tips.sRefereeInst: Baza umusifuzi wo muri {{institution}} wakubonye uyobora, ntabwo akwigisha gusa - Chevening-style-panel panels uburemere kumanota wenyine.
tips.sRefereeGeneric: Kurinda abasifuzi babiri bashobora kuvuga gahunda yihariye wayoboye - inyuguti zidasobanutse "umunyeshuri ukora cyane" inyuguti zikomeye.
tips.sCalendar: Kubaka igihe ntarengwa cyo guhindura ikirangantego kuva "{{deadline}}" hamwe na buffer zo kwandukura inyandiko, ibizamini, hamwe na references.
tips.sOffline: Inyandiko isubiza kumurongo ubanza, hanyuma wandike kumurongo - auto-save glitches isiba amasaha yakazi kumpapuro nyinshi za buruse.
tips.sAlumni: Ubushakashatsi 2 barangije muri {{place}} batsinze {{source}}; reba ibyo basabye bashimangiye kandi bagaragaze imiterere, ntabwo ari inkuru.
tips.sScore: Niba amanota yawe ahuye ari {{score}}%, fata icyuho ubunyangamugayo mu nyandiko - paneli ihemba kwimenyekanisha kuruta ibisabwa.
tips.sHeadline: Huza umutwe wawe (“{{headline}}”) hamwe na gahunda yavuzwe na gahunda kugirango ecran ya mbere yamaze kumva nkana.
tips.sPitch: Tegura 60-amasegonda 60 mumagambo ya gahunda yawe yo kwiga kubazwa: ikibazo → inkombe yawe → {{source}} nkumuvuduko.
tips.sProof: Kusanya ibihangano bifatika (GitHub, raporo, ibihembo, amabaruwa yabaturage) asubiza inyuma ubuhanga bwose wanditse - amashusho yiteguye mbere yo gusaba.
tips.sEligibility: Reba ubwenegihugu no gusubira murugo ingingo ya {{source}} ukurikije imiterere yawe {{country}} iyi cycle - amakosa yujuje ibisabwa asesagura inyandiko zikomeye.
tips.sBio: Ongera wandike bio yawe kugirango umuntu utazi muri {{location}} yumve umurima wawe mu nteruro imwe, hanyuma wagure.
tips.sCheveningCourses: Toranya amasomo atatu yo mu Bwongereza akwiranye rwose {{field}}, ntabwo ari icyubahiro wenyine - Chevening yanze inyigisho eshatu zidahuye nubwo wanditse.
tips.sCheveningNet: Koresha urupapuro rwuzuye kuri gahunda ya "rezo": societe zo mubwongereza, laboratoire, cyangwa amatsinda ya politiki uzinjiramo, nicyo uzana kuri {{place}}.
tips.sDaadFilter: Shungura DAAD ukurikije urwego rwawe rwose na {{field}}, hanyuma uhitemo urutonde 2 guhamagara - rusange "Ubudage" porogaramu ni gake usiba icyambere.
tips.sDaadLang: Hitamo hakiri kare niba ukeneye ibimenyetso byubudage cyangwa Icyongereza kuri porogaramu yakiriye, hanyuma wandike itariki yikizamini mbere yuko umuhamagaro urangira.
tips.sMastercardApply: Koresha binyuze muri kaminuza ifatanyabikorwa yigisha {{field}} - Mastercard Scholars ni ikigo cyihariye, ntabwo ari uburyo bumwe bwisi.
tips.sMastercardNeed: Inyandiko ikeneye nubuyobozi hamwe: igika kimwe kuri bariyeri, imwe kubyo umaze guhindura kubandi muri {{place}}.
tips.sFulbrightPage: Koresha urupapuro rwigihugu rwa Fulbright gusa - igihe ntarengwa nuburyo bwa {{country}} bitandukanye nigitabo cyisi.
tips.sFulbrightObj: Kora ubushakashatsi / kwiga intego yibeshya: nikihe kibazo muri {{field}} uzasubiza mumezi 12-24?
tips.sGates: Cambridge fit iraza mbere: vuga umuyobozi cyangwa itsinda rya laboratoire ijyanye na {{field}} mbere yo gutunganya amagambo ya Gatesi.
tips.sTheme: Huza icyifuzo cyawe ku nsanganyamatsiko yatangajwe kuva {{source}}, ukoresheje imvugo ihamagarwa - kudahuza insanganyamatsiko ni ukwanga guceceka.
tips.jResume: Ongera wandike incamake ya résumé kugirango uyobore na {{skill}} + {{field}}, hanyuma ushireho inshinga 5 zambere muri buri {{source}} wohereze.
tips.jProof: Kubaka urupapuro 1 "urupapuro rwerekana" hamwe namasasu 3: ikibazo, ibikorwa ukoresheje {{skills}}, ibisubizo bipimwa.
tips.jAdvanced: Shyira {{skills}} mugice cya gatatu cya LinkedIn / Ibyerekeye - abashaka akazi skim, ntabwo bahiga.
tips.jWeak: Ku nshingano zisaba {{skill}}, ongeramo mini-umushinga wikendi hanyuma uyihuze - ibisabwa hagati nta bimenyetso bishungura.
tips.jAlerts: Shiraho {{source}} imenyesha rya “{{field}}” n'igihugu cyawe ({{country}}), hanyuma usabe mumasaha 48 yoherejwe.
tips.jTarget: Itegereze ibigo 5 buri cyumweru bitanga akazi kuri {{field}} muri cyangwa kuva kuri {{country}}, ntabwo ari 50 Byoroshye Gusaba gukanda.
tips.jCover: Muri buri nyandiko yerekana, vuga ikintu kimwe cyatanzwe ushobora kohereza muminsi 30 yambere ukoresheje stack yawe.
tips.jReferrals: Baza kubohereza nyuma yuko ushobora gusobanura ibicuruzwa byikipe mu nteruro 2 - imbeho ibaza idafite umukoro watwitse ibiraro.
tips.jLoom: Andika 90-amasegonda 90 (cyangwa inoti yijwi) ugenda mumushinga; kuyihuza mugihe {{source}} yemerera ubutumwa / gusaba inyongera.
tips.jConfidence: Ibyiringiro byawe bihuye ni ~ {{score}}% - niba munsi ya 70%, komeza ubuhanga kuri Profile hanyuma usubiremo mbere yo gutera porogaramu.
tips.jTranslate: Sobanura ururimi rwamasomo kuva {{field}} mururimi rwumukoresha: "amasomo" → "yatanzwe X mugihe ntarengwa".
tips.jLog: Komeza logi yo kwangwa: uruhare, kubura ubuhanga, igikorwa gikurikira - imiterere ikubwira icyo wiga gikurikira vuba kuruta gukeka.
tips.jLinkedinOpen: Fungura Gufungura Akazi (abashaka akazi gusa) hanyuma ushireho umushinga ugaragaza {{skill}}.
tips.jLinkedinComment: Tanga ibitekerezo witonze kumyanya 3 yo gutanga akazi-umuyobozi muri {{field}} muri iki cyumweru mbere yo gukonjesha - ubushyuhe bugaragara bukubita bucece Saba.
tips.jIndeed: Koresha Mubyukuri ibibanza byungururwa neza nka "{{country}}" hanyuma utondekane kumatariki - stale isubiramo ingufu zimyanda.
tips.jRemoteOk: Soma umurongo wigihugu / timezone inshuro ebyiri kuri Remote OK - inshingano nyinshi "za kure" ziracyakuyemo {{country}}.
tips.jRemoteRate: Gura igipimo cya rwiyemezamirimo hamwe na timezone byuzuye imbere mubutumwa bwambere kugirango wirinde kuzimu nyuma ya ecran.
tips.jGlassdoor: Soma raporo iheruka kubazwa kuri uriya mukoresha, hanyuma utegure inkuru 2 zisubiza ibibazo byakunze kugarukwaho.
tips.jReliefImpact: Kuyobora porogaramu hamwe ningaruka / ubushake bwabakorerabushake muri {{place}} - ReliefWeb itanga uburemere buremereye ubutumwa bujyanye nuburambe.
tips.jReliefLang: Huza ururimi ruvuye mu myanya (Ifunguro, kurinda, WASH, nibindi) gusa niba ushobora kubirwanaho - ibintu byuzuye amagambo biragaragara.
tips.jHeadline: Gereranya umutwe wawe rusange kuri "{{headline}}" ahantu hose usaba kugirango {{source}} ecran na CV yawe vuga inkuru imwe.
